title.en: Genova No Deshi  ~ 10 Byo Shika Tatakaenai Majutsushi, Nochi no Mao o Sodateru ~

altTitles.ja: ジェノヴァの弟子 1 ~10秒しか戦えない魔術師、のちの『魔王』を育てる~

description.en: An unusual master-disciple adventure tale begins! Can a former strongest mage, with a 10-second combat limit, and his cross-dressing female apprentice (desperate to hide her gender) save the world? The former strongest mage's apprentice is actually the Demon Lord!? This is the story of a certain master and apprentice on their journey. The master, Valen, was once known as the "Strongest Mage," but after a tragic event, he lost his beloved master, his sight, and all of his magical power. Now, Valen can only use his former powers for 10 seconds at a time, and he’s awkward around women. His apprentice, Ria, is a magical prodigy who forced her way into becoming Valen's apprentice, almost like a wife barging in. However, she’s determined to hide the fact that she's a woman at all costs. When Ria reveals the shocking truth that “Valen’s master is still alive,” their strange journey begins. But for some reason, their adventures lead to the potential destruction of the human world!? This is a fantasy adventure of a once-invincible mage with a 10-second limit and a cross-dressing girl with a secret!
description.ja:
とある師弟が旅をする物語…。師匠は、かつて『最強魔術師』と称されたが、とある事件で最愛の師匠と視力、魔力の全てを失う。その名はヴァレン。今や、たった10秒しかかつての力が出せない、女性が苦手な鈍感魔術師だ。弟子の名はリア。魔力を失ったヴァレンに半ば、押しかけ女房の如く弟子入りを果たした、魔術の才能の塊。だが自身が女性であることは死んでも隠す所存だ。
10秒しか戦えない元最強魔術師と、とある秘密を抱えた男装女子によるファンタジー冒険譚!
